Deine Rolle bei uns

 Du schlägst die Brücke zwischen echten Kundenbedürfnissen und starken technischen Lösungen? 

Das ist die Formel der Formeln für User Stories. Du kennst sie natürlich in- und auswendig. Und du weißt auch, dass sich hinter den Variablen viel Sorgfalt und Organisation, aber auch ausgeprägte Kommunikation verbirgt. Denkst du, dass du auch in flachen Hierarchien sensibel kommunizieren kannst und dein Kompass auf agil steht? Dann bist du richtig!

Wir suchen einen Product Owner als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und Team, der dazu versteht, wertmaximierend zu handeln, ohne dass es Übersetzungsfehler gibt. Ein Product Owner, der es schafft, in flachen Hierarchien sensibel zu kommunizieren und dessen Mindset dabei stets agil bleibt. Oder mit anderen Worten: Als [Job] möchte ich [in einem tollen Team arbeiten], um [das Beste rauszuholen - aus mir und aus den anderen].

jobs.title: Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology.  Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

  • You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.
  • Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
  • Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level
  • Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials
  • Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.
  • Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.
  • Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials
  • Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

  • Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.
  • Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.
    • Experience managing studies within Oncology 
    • Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally
  • Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development. 

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Open Source Software
jobs.description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid 

Salary: £68,000 to £84,000 DOE 

We will also consider part-time applications for this role. Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.  

 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. 

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast. 

 

About the role 

Deltakit is Riverlane’s open-source software development kit (SDK) for QEC which is designed to help researchers build, test and run QEC workflows as the field of quantum computing rapidly evolves. 

You’ll sit right at the heart of Deltakit, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most. 

You’ll own and evolve Deltakit’s strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision. You’ll strike the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today, helping us build for the future of quantum computing while delivering value right now. 

Beyond the roadmap, you’ll play a key role in bringing Deltakit to life for the community. From supporting launches to engaging directly with users, you’ll shape how we show up, tell our story, and communicate the product’s value in a way that excites and inspires people to build with it.

 

What you will do

  • Engage with users, partners and the open-source community to gather insight and feedback 
  • Analyse product usage, developer behaviour and the broader ecosystem to inform priorities

jobs.description:

Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.

jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 The Role
 As a Product Operations Manager (Design) , you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics.
 You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead.
 Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships.
 This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team.
 
 What You Will Do
 Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward.

 Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs.

 Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late.

 Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org.

 Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated.

 Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax.

 Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin.

 Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing.

 Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping.

 
 What We're Looking For
 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization.

 A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones.

 Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority.

 Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings.

 Design literacy — enough background to have felt the pain designers feel and to be credible with the team.

 A make-it-happen attitude: positive, bias to action, unblocks rather than escalates.

 Excellent communication and synthesis skills — you turn scattered signals into a shared source of truth.

 Ability to thrive in ambiguity and define your own scope in a role with no playbook and no team to delegate to.

 
 What We Offer

Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1.  Tu es à l'aise sur le Product Delivery et l'ensemble des rituels Agiles.

 Compétences relationnelles 🎙

 Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

 You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. Über Uns 
 Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis. 
 Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit. 
 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech. 

 Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, Gemini sowie Design-Software wie Figma, um Analysen, Nutzerflows, Produktideen und erste Prototypen schneller zu entwickeln. 

 Du entwickelst die Produkt Roadmap für apeiron und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams detaillierte Produktanforderungen, User Stories und Abnahmekriterien. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen im Unternehmen sowie mit externen Partnern und weiteren Interessengruppen zusammen und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit ihnen ab. 

 Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen. 

 Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. 

 Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen. 

 Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei. 

 
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium. 

 Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld. 

 Du bringst Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im deutschen Vermögensverwaltungssystem mit, idealerweise im Umfeld unabhängiger Finanzberater:innen oder Vermögensverwalter. 

 Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus. 

 Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Claude for Design, Framer, Grafana, Brevo oder Figma. 

 Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen. 

 Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen. 

 Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch. 

 Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen. 
 

 Warum Ginmon? 
 Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität. 

 Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine. 

 Beteiligung am langfristigen Erfolg von Ginmon durch ein Virtual Employee Share Option Program (VESOP). 

 Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments und Nutzung unserer Plattform; 

 Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

 Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts mit High-End-Equipment und optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung. 

 Regelmäßige Teamevents und eine angenehme Büroatmosphäre (Snacks, Getränke, Firmen-Merch u. v. m.). 

 Erstattung deiner Internetkosten und der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket. 

 Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Exclaimer is the leading email signature management vendor. Our product appeals to companies who need their employees’ emails to include disclaimers and signatures with consistent branding.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our product-led growth (PLG) motion, with a particular focus on the self-serve onboarding flow on www.exclaimer.com: the path a new user takes from signup through activation, to their first meaningful "aha" moment during a trial, to becoming a paying customer.

You’ll be working closely with our Head of PLG, with whom you agree improvements to the onboarding flow. Your impact on activation and time-to-value translates directly into revenue, retention, and lower cost of acquisition.

  • Report on PLG health to leadership, translating funnel data into a clear narrative and a prioritised action plan.

Experience

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo. 

The Role

We are seeking an Integration Product Manager to lead the integrations that power daily operations for Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs). In this role, you will be responsible for the workflows and tools that connect Addepar with key ecosystem partners, primarily focused on Salesforce and Custodial integrations.

jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

 
 
 About This Role: 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

 This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

 We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

 
 Our Benefits: 

 At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

 
 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

 A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will:

 
 Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

 Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

 Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

 Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

 Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

 Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

 Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 
 
 Your Profile: 

 
 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

 A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

 Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

 Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

 Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

 Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.

 A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.

 Fluent English required

Employment type: Permanent, full-time, Office first

The Consumer Lifecycle team owns the product experience that turns SumUp app signups into active, transacting customers - from onboarding through to first transaction and ongoing engagement.  As the sole Product Manager for consumer activation and engagement, you  will own that funnel end to end, improving conversion at every stage.

  • Balance fraud and verification controls with a smooth, user-friendly product experience
  • Run discovery, experimentation and iteration cycles against activation targets, and report progress to consumer leadership

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience leading a consumer product area with clear commercial and KPI accountability
  • Strong track record of prioritising effectively across competing demands from multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Experience driving engagement or retention within a consumer-facing mobile app used at scale
  • Comfort balancing risk or compliance requirements against a smooth, user-friendly product experience
  • Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, design, data and marketing, and communicate progress clearly to leadership

  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

jobs.title: Product Manager - EXOtube
jobs.description:
Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across  48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube . Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager  is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand. 

 Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany . The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. 

 Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . 

 Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. 

 Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. 

 Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. 

 Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. 

 Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. 

 Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . 

 Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. 

 Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level 

 Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. 

 

 Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 

 5+ years of engineering work experience. 

 Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. 

 Excellent written and spoken English. 

 Excellent technical communication skills. 

 Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. 

 Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design. 

 Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting. 

 Ability to work in a fast-paced and demanding environment. 

 Flexibility for travel, occasionally at short notice 

 

 Why us? Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities 

 Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility 

 Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere 

 State-of-the-art Office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz 

 Access to an in-house gym at the HQ 

 All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively 

 Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment 

 Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events

 Neural Concept is at the intersection of 3D deep learning and industrial engineering, building the tools that help the world's leading manufacturers design better products, faster. We're looking for a Product Manager who has lived the reality of engineering workflows inside large industrial organizations — and who is equally excited about where the industry is going. You understand what it feels like to wait on a simulation, to navigate a multi-year vehicle program, and to work within the constraints of a legacy toolchain. And you've seen — or been part of — what's possible when engineering meets modern AI and software. A formal "PM" title is not required; what matters is proven product thinking, sharp communication, and the humility to deeply understand problems that are different from your own experience. This is a rare role at the intersection of engineering credibility and product craft — and a unique opportunity to shape how AI transforms one of the most consequential domains in the world.
 
 What you will do 
 Engage deeply with customers — OEM engineering teams, simulation specialists, and program managers — to understand their day-to-day workflows, frustrations, and unmet needs, bringing genuine curiosity and listening skills to every interaction.

 Translate customer insight, market signals, and technical feasibility into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmap decisions, in close collaboration with Engineering and the leadership team.

 Own the product discovery process: design and run user research, synthesize findings across customer segments, and develop hypotheses that the team can build, test, and iterate on.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Application Engineering, and Marketing to ensure product decisions are grounded in real customer value and commercial viability.

 Represent the voice of industrial engineers internally — keeping the product technically credible, practically useful, and commercially sharp.

 Track trends in engineering software, advanced simulation, and AI tooling to identify whitespace, emerging use cases, and competitive positioning opportunities.

 
 Who you are 
 You have 3+ years of real engineering experience inside a large industrial organization — you know what it feels like to work on multi-year programs, navigate complex systems, and live with the constraints of real-world manufacturing or product development.

 You've also been exposed to a more modern environment — whether at a fast-moving hardware company, a next-gen engineering software startup, or a tech company embedded in industrial accounts — and you're energized by what AI and software can unlock for engineering teams.

 You bring genuine product instincts: you listen more than you talk, you're curious about problems that are different from your own engineering experience, and you know how to bring people along without having formal authority.

 You communicate with precision — in writing and in conversation — and you make prioritization decisions with structure and clear reasoning.

 You hold a degree in engineering or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree (MSc, PhD) is a plus.

 You are fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

 
 We know this combination of skills is rare. If you have one deep engineering experience — whether at a legacy industrial company or a modern company like Tesla or SpaceX — and strong product instincts, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Deine Position

 As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you will play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value.

 
 Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

 Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

 Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

 Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

 Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

 Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

 
 Dein Profil

 General:

 
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field

 At least one prior internship, working student role, or comparable work placement (in energy, consulting, product, or a fast-moving startup environment preferred)

 Strong ownership mindset - comfortable driving your own initiatives with minimal handholding (with support always available from your direct lead)

 Analytical and structured thinker, comfortable with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets a must, SQL or Python a plus)

 Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-moving environment

 You are a team player who enjoys collaborative environments and is always looking to leverage the group’s potential

 Available for at least 6 months, ideally full-time

 Excellent written and spoken English and German

 
 Market & Domain Exposure:

 
 Previous experience or knowledge of the energy market is a plus but we are happy to get you up to speed - it’s the motivation that counts!

 Basic understanding of European energy market structures, dynamic tariffs, or the energy transition landscape

 
 Benefits

 
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

You'll work alongside diverse, cross-border teams and supportive colleagues who share knowledge and want to see you succeed. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Klaxoon — the product area responsible for Wrike’s visual collaboration strategy and the evolution of whiteboarding experiences within the broader CWM platform.

In this role, you will define and lead the strategy of Wrike Whiteboards across the key pillars: whiteboard core experience, AI strategy, vertical-oriented use cases, convergence between Wrike and Klaxoon, and customer retention. You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration. You will help transform Klaxoon into a world-class visual collaboration tool while developing the PM team into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Define and drive the Klaxoon strategy: Set the vision, priorities, and roadmap for Klaxoon across the core whiteboard experience, AI strategy, vertical differentiation, and Wrike/Klaxoon convergence into a single seamless product.
  • Grow whiteboard adoption and experience: Continuously raise the bar on the Klaxoon product experience to make it a world-class visual collaboration tool, with strong focus on driving adoption among Wrike customers and identifying high-value vertical use cases.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to work AI-natively, identifying where agentic workflows can change how the team operates and scales output.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers - helping them move from feature ownership to strategic product leadership while building a shared product culture across Wrike and Klaxoon.

Your qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, positioning, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer expectations, product convergence, innovation, and long-term strategic direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • AI-native thinking: Practical understanding of AI-native product strategy and ability to identify differentiated AI use cases in visual collaboration.
  • Good UX judgment: Ability to balance product power, simplicity, adoption, and customer experience in collaborative tools.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in visual collaboration, whiteboarding, CWM, work management, or team collaboration products.
  • Practical understanding of agentic workflows and AI-native product development.
  • Proficiency in French is a strong plus - the team is mostly France-based.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex product areas for the AI-native future.

jobs.title: Product Manager (12 month FTC)
jobs.description:
Product at HelloFresh is exciting. We’re talking recipe ranges, box types and, or product additions such as our surcharge portfolio (range of value added recipes that customers can pay extra for to acquire).  Reporting directly into our Head of Menu Strategy and Product Development,  you will sit at the vital intersection of customer, operations and web-development. Without this team, we can’t stay number one globally and so we want someone to come in and use their energy, passion and outstanding project management to help us continue to give customers the best products in the market.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Strategically own and manage the end-to-end range and assortment planning for Surcharge (HelloFresh and GC) and Market for HelloFresh UK. This involves significant collaboration with the global HFM team, who manage much of the strategic planning, to ensure local execution aligns with global initiatives while driving basket penetration and safeguarding high-margin revenue streams.
  • Lead performance reporting and tracking across all value-added revenue streams, utilizing data-driven insights to optimize product performance, drive margin growth, and identify opportunities for AOV and basket expansion.
  • Drive innovation by curating and sourcing new concepts, premium recipes, and high-performing Market additions that enhance customer value perception and complement our core meal kit offering.
  • Collaborate closely with the culinary team to translate new product concepts and insights into tangible, appealing recipes that align with our surcharge and market strategies.
  • Own the process for new SKU proposals, forecasting, and assortment refinement, bridging the gap between innovation and commercial viability to ensure every addition contributes to long-term profitability.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure flawless execution of the product innovation roadmap for value added products, playing a key role in helping shape the future of HelloFresh UK’s premium product strategy.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Brand teams to build compelling commercial stories for value-added products, maximizing customer lifetime value through targeted initiatives.
  • Being a champion for your customers within the business

Who You Are:

  • 3-5 years’ experience within either a commercial FMCG role, such as brand / category management (e-commerce experience is a bonus), or a top tier consultancy within these industries
  • Outstanding project management skills, and the ability to keep the plates spinning
  • Able to work cross-functionally to drive through product initiatives in a complex structure with global stakeholders
  • Confidence working with data to build business cases and make recommendations to the UK and global teams
  • Customer-centric mindset, including the ability to use data to identify unmet customer needs and pain points
  • Creative thinking to develop solutions that solve our customers’ challenges and an entrepreneurial attitude.
  • Experience is executing digital tests and working with digital products.  
  • Experience in food, e-commerce and digital merchandising would be a bonus.

What you will get in return:

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Dog friendly office! (London site only)
● Nursery support scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance

Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London

jobs.description:

 Location: London, United Kingdom 

 Employment type: Permanent, full-time, Office first

 Team description

 The Consumer Lifecycle team owns the product experience that turns SumUp app signups into active, transacting customers - from onboarding through to first transaction and ongoing engagement. As the sole Product Manager for consumer activation and engagement, you will own that funnel end to end, improving conversion at every stage. 

 What you'll do

 
 Own the consumer onboarding funnel end to end: signup, identity verification (KYC), first funding, first transaction and habitual use

 Identify and ship product improvements at the biggest drop-off points, starting with the gap between KYC completion and first transaction

 Balance fraud and verification controls with a smooth, user-friendly product experience

 Run discovery, experimentation and iteration cycles against activation targets, and report progress to consumer leadership

 
 You'll be great for this role if…

 
 Experience leading a consumer product area with clear commercial and KPI accountability

 Strong track record of prioritising effectively across competing demands from multiple teams and stakeholders

 Experience driving engagement or retention within a consumer-facing mobile app used at scale

 Comfort balancing risk or compliance requirements against a smooth, user-friendly product experience

 Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, design, data and marketing, and communicate progress clearly to leadership

 
 Why you should join SumUp

 
 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our London Bridge location. This role

 involves an office-first setup

 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

 About SumUp

 Be empowered to do more that matters.

 At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

 

 Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Sports Trading
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead one of our trading product teams and help achieve our vision of providing unique and entertaining betting experiences to customers around the world. You will join the wider Product Management department, working with the best talent to design and deliver industry-leading products that drive customer and business value in our Sports product. Specifically, you will progress our Football offer and proposition, working closely with our Quants, Engineering and Trading teams to leverage our internal Football model and differentiate Super from our competitors.

What the role involves

Customer and Competitor Insight

  • Lead on customer understanding, discovery and defining customer value for our products.
  • Leverage AI to drive discovery and utilise customer feedback from multiple touchpoints across the organisation to build a picture of customer problems, opportunities and behaviour.
  • Make data-driven decisions using customer research, behavioural, product and commercial data, working with AI & Data Analysts to develop the reporting capabilities needed to measure customer behaviour and product engagement.
  • Define what success looks like for our product and take responsibility for its measurement in-life, testing and iterating to achieve the product objectives, whilst maintaining ongoing awareness of our key competitors and their offering.

Execution

  • Own the Football model driven product journey end to end, ensuring customer value is always the team's key priority, providing domain expertise and developing deep knowledge of the Super product.
  • Identify and understand customer behaviour and needs to define the hypotheses and requirements that shape suitable features for the Football model.
  • Create best-in-class product features and journeys that take the player experience to the next level, working with engineers and stakeholders to define and deliver reliable, scalable solutions to customer problems.
  • Coordinate product launch plans with Go To Market, marketing, commercial, operations and support teams, whilst remaining aware of regulatory compliance, GDPR requirements and the legal positioning of the Sports Betting and Gaming industry and how these impact product features and requirements.

Influencing People

  • Engage with your stakeholders to understand their expectations and incorporate their feedback where appropriate.
  • Set the right expectations with stakeholders and effectively communicate status and progress on outcomes and deliverables.

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Build and maintain a roadmap for your area that delivers short-term and long-term objectives aligned to the overall company and product strategy, driving it from ideation and product discovery through to in-life product.
  • Prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business viability and technical feasibility, and input into defining the quarterly Objectives and Key Results for your product team.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years' experience as a Product Manager working with Engineering teams.
  • Sports Trading product experience, building products that scale.
  • Knowledge of Sports Betting Trading systems.
  • Customer-focused and data-driven, with a passion for solving customer problems.
  • Strong AI competencies to reduce time to market and time to customer value.
  • Self-motivated and organised, with the ability to drive product strategy.
  • Understanding of technology and agile development methodologies.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Excellent English language skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with sports models, as this role works directly with our Football model.

What we offer

  • Medical / Health Insurance
  • Open Annual Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Training & Learning Development

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.
 About the Role 
 Summary 
 Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.
  
 We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.
  
 This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of.
 Outcomes & KPIs 
 Key Outcome(s) Owned: 
 End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability.

 A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on.

 
 Success Metrics / KPIs 
 Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window.

 Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.

 Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release.

 Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

 Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

 What You'll Do 
 Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy.

 Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

 Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.
